plan_summary: Inspect the required public API docs, retrieve supervisor account context without exposing secrets, paginate through artist and song searches, derive the unique highest-play-count song for the exact artist, and submit its title.

steps.reasoning: The public documentation must be inspected before any task API is called so that subsequent calls use only documented parameters and response fields.
verification_targets: Public documentation for every required task API is stored before its first use

steps.reasoning: The supervisor profile and Spotify account credential must be obtained through the documented Supervisor APIs and retained privately for account context; no Spotify login API is present in the supplied public schema.
steps.action_code:
supervisor_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
supervisor_account_passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_account_record = next((record for record in supervisor_account_passwords if record["account_name"].casefold() == "spotify"), None)
spotify_password = spotify_account_record["password"] if spotify_account_record is not None else None
supervisor_email = supervisor_profile["email"]
verification_targets: Spotify password is retained only in a variable and is not printed

steps.reasoning: All artist-search pages must be collected before selecting the artist, because an exact match may occur on any page.
steps.action_code:
artist_results = []
artist_page_index = 0
while True:
    artist_page = apis.spotify.search_artists(query="Jasper Skye", page_index=artist_page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not artist_page:
        break
    artist_results.extend(artist_page)
    artist_page_index += 1
print([{"artist_id": artist["artist_id"], "name": artist["name"], "follower_count": artist["follower_count"]} for artist in artist_results])
verification_targets: Artist pages are requested sequentially until an empty page is returned
Public artist candidates are available for exact-name selection

steps.reasoning: The requested artist must be selected from the observed search results by exact case-insensitive name rather than by a hardcoded identifier or assumed search rank.
steps.action_code:
target_artist_name = "Jasper Skye"
exact_artist_matches = [artist for artist in artist_results if artist["name"].casefold() == target_artist_name.casefold()]
if len(exact_artist_matches) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("The public search results did not contain exactly one exact artist-name match")
selected_artist = exact_artist_matches[0]
selected_artist_id = selected_artist["artist_id"]
print({"artist_id": selected_artist_id, "name": selected_artist["name"]})
verification_targets: Exactly one case-insensitive exact match for Jasper Skye is selected
The artist identifier comes from a real public search result

steps.reasoning: Every song page for the selected artist must be read so the maximum play count is computed over the complete public result set.
steps.action_code:
artist_songs = []
song_page_index = 0
while True:
    song_page = apis.spotify.search_songs(artist_id=selected_artist_id, page_index=song_page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by="-play_count")
    if not song_page:
        break
    artist_songs.extend(song_page)
    song_page_index += 1
print({"artist_id": selected_artist_id, "song_count": len(artist_songs)})
verification_targets: Song pages are requested sequentially until an empty page is returned
All returned songs are filtered by the derived artist identifier

steps.reasoning: With the complete song set available, the answer can be derived from the observed play_count values and reviewed for a unique maximum before submission.
steps.action_code:
if not artist_songs:
    raise RuntimeError("No songs were returned for the selected artist")
maximum_play_count = max(song["play_count"] for song in artist_songs)
most_played_candidates = [song for song in artist_songs if song["play_count"] == maximum_play_count]
if len(most_played_candidates) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("The public song results did not contain a unique most-played song")
most_played_song = most_played_candidates[0]
answer = most_played_song["title"]
print([{"title": song["title"], "play_count": song["play_count"]} for song in most_played_candidates])
verification_targets: A unique maximum play count is identified
The answer is the title field of the uniquely most-played public song record
